caption: 01 · DEPEND — Which memory exists only elsewhere?. Inventory source URL, platform, account owner, identifier, format, access condition, geography, login, cost, rights, and evidence use.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping which memory exists only elsewhere? within The Cost of Link-Only Culture.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 02 · PERMIT — What may lawfully be retained?. Separate public visibility, download ability, license, authorized embed, preservation copy, quotation, metadata, and link. Review contracts and jurisdiction where uncertain.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what may lawfully be retained? within The Cost of Link-Only Culture.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 03 · DESCRIBE — What survives without the media?. Write a faithful factual description, creator and institution credit, date, identifier, evidentiary relevance, rights status, and retrieval history without substituting invented imagery.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what survives without the media? within The Cost of Link-Only Culture.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 04 · RECOVER — What happens after failure?. Schedule link checks, preserve redirects and replacement records, document loss, contact stewards, update citations, and keep correction history.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what happens after failure? within The Cost of Link-Only Culture.

caption: Preservation rhetoric can become a justification for copying creators’ work without consent. Conversely, rights uncertainty can erase minoritized histories first. The response is resourced permission work, accurate metadata, lawful preservation, and transparent absence.
